scripts-descriptions.test: Clears the build caches, then runs the PHPUnit suite against the kozter_testing database. Use this, never `artisan test` - that one boots the framework first, so .env wins over phpunit.xml and RefreshDatabase would wipe the application database.

PKSA-m5cs-t1y6-qpcs.reason: Temporary signed URL path confusion. Fixed in 12.61.1 only - no Laravel 9 backport and Laravel 9 is EOL. Becomes obsolete at Phase 9 (TODO 61), the first hop that reaches a fixed release. Unblocks resolution only; composer audit still reports it. See upgrade-roadmap.md, TODO 34.

PKSA-3r5d-mb8f-1qw9.reason: CRLF injection in the default email validation rule, the GitHub advisory record of GHSA-5vg9-5847-vvmq. Fixed in 12.60.0 only - no Laravel 9 backport; the strictEmail middleware is the mitigation actually in place. Becomes obsolete at Phase 9 (TODO 61). Unblocks resolution only; composer audit still reports it. See upgrade-roadmap.md, TODO 34.

PKSA-mdq4-51ck-6kdq.reason: CVE-2026-48019 - the SECOND Packagist record of the same GHSA-5vg9-5847-vvmq CRLF issue as PKSA-3r5d-mb8f-1qw9. Its affected range starts at 9.0.0, which is why it blocks from Laravel 9 onwards and never blocked Laravel 8. Same fix (12.60.0), same mitigation, same expiry as the entry above. Unblocks resolution only; composer audit still reports it. See upgrade-roadmap.md, TODO 34.
